description: Search the EBI Electron Microscopy Data Bank (EMDB) for 3D cryo-EM / electron-tomography density maps by free-text keyword (e.g. "ribosome", "spike protein", "apoptosis"). Returns matching maps with EMDB id, title, resolution (Angstrom), and structure-determination method. Keyless. Complements PDB/AlphaFold (which hold atomic/experimental structures).
name: search_maps
title: Search Maps
